# SCHLÜSSELMACHER24 - Architecture and DNA

This project follows strict Next.js 16+, React 19.2+, and TypeScript 5.5+ standards.
The styling is moving towards Tailwind CSS v4 OKLCH Light Mode.

See `.jules/revolution-plan.json` for the transformation queue of UI routes, ensuring minimum word counts and interactive components, and `.jules/architecture-matrix.md` for the audit status.

## Rules
- ZERO-NEW-ROUTES
- Read-Only App Code during Audit Phase
- OKLCH Chromatic Structure

## Target Architecture Blueprint
Please reference the generated `.jules/` files for detailed blueprints.
